saveHashScope: All files recursively under SaveManager's saves directory; Unity Editor Analytics is outside the player save directory.
saveIsolation: Direct Farm bootstrap; SaveInput disabled in memory before Play Mode. No save/load calls. Scene reopened without saving on exit.
limitations: Static camera views at current gameplay aspect. Teleports are framing only; do not prove movement, collision traversal, animation fluidity or human acceptance. Bounds include sprite geometry, not alpha-only silhouette. Screen Space Overlay UI is not rendered by Camera.Render.

physicalRoutes.reason: All approaches connected; dock water blocked; every sampled natural boundary segment blocks outward player-collider sweeps.
physicalRoutes.method: Cardinal BFS at 0.5 world units; actual player collider OverlapCollider and Cast with Physics2D layer collision mask; each route starts at captured spawn. No movement input, interaction or animation is simulated.

interactionSelection.method: Real InteractionSystem.GetCurrentInteractable after >=2 physics steps, from BFS endpoint or a collider-swept local position within 2u; no Interact or injected candidates. House door, three craft stations, exterior farm cave entrance FishingSpot and town portal; decorative well excluded. Selection never executes a scene transition or fishing action.
